data.description: GLASGOW - Australia rounded off their best-ever Commonwealth Games in the pool with nine more swimming gold medals on Wednesday for a total of 37, while Kate O'Connor cruised to heptathlon gold for Northern Ireland.

data.title: Refreshed Jeeno ready for big test at Lytham
data.description: Thai world No.2 Jeeno Thitikul is ready for her next challenge at the Women's British Open at Royal Lytham & St Annes in England after taking a break to recharge.

data.title: Idi Amin's grandson disqualified from Commonwealth boxing bout
data.description: GLASGOW - The grandson of former Ugandan president Idi Amin saw his bid for Commonwealth boxing gold end in disgrace as Aziz Abdul was disqualified for a headbutt in his quarter-final on Wednesday.

data.title: Supanida snaps losing run to reach last 16
data.description: Supanida Katethong finally ended her first round losing spell when the Thai left-hander won her opening match at the US$250,000 (approx 8.4 million baht) BWF Taipei Open on Wednesday.

data.title: Thailand back to hard graft after day off
data.description: Thailand's national team were back on the training pitch at BGTC 3 on Wednesday, stepping up preparations for their Group B second fixture against Malaysia in the Asean Hyundai Cup 2026.

data.title: ONE Championship: Dayakaev vows to prove he is ‘complete’ fighter by beating Superlek again
data.description: Abdulla Dayakaev wants to turn one controversial victory over Superlek into an undeniable statement at The Inner Circle 25 – and prove he possesses far more than the punching power that made his name.

data.title: ONE Championship: Superlek backs himself to beat Dayakaev ‘easily’ as flyweight talk grows
data.description: Superlek believes he can avenge his controversial defeat by Abdulla Dayakaev “easily” at The Inner Circle 25 – as pressure grows on the Thai star to end his three-fight losing run and finally address the future of his long-dormant flyweight kickboxing title.

data.title: A day with a master: Woosie's swing still had its magic
data.description: The definition of the phrase 'Paths Crossed' comes from the literal image of two physical paths or trails intersecting. Metaphorically, it implies that the journeys of two people briefly overlapped. The phrase is often used to suggest an element of fate or destiny in a surprise encounter. My encounter with Ian Woosnam was on a driving range in Poland, where he was hitting a few balls prior to playing in a seniors' event.

data.title: Eseme, Hobbs shine in Glasgow rain to win 100m Commonwealth gold
data.description: GLASGOW - Cameroon's Emmanuel Eseme defied the torrential rain in Glasgow to win the men's 100 metres in a Commonwealth Games record time on Tuesday as New Zealand's Zoe Hobbs surged to a surprise victory in the women's 100m.

data.title: Thais will rule Asean, claims former captain
data.description: Theerathon Bunmathan believes Thailand possess the quality to win the Asean Hyundai Cup this year, even after their opening victory over Laos was tougher than many expected.

data.title: FIFA says it hopes to sell $4.2bn stake in its tournaments
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - FIFA said Tuesday it plans to sell a stake in the business operations of the World Cup and its other competitions through the creation of a semi-private subsidiary.

data.title: ONE Championship: Johan Ghazali promises ‘beast is coming’ after heated Ramadan Ondash face-off
data.description: Johan Ghazali has promised to ride the wave created in Malaysia by Aliff Sor Dechapan’s historic ONE Championship title triumph – and unleash “the beast” against Ramadan Ondash in Friday’s Inner Circle 24 co-main event.

data.title: France turns to Zidane to bring football glory
data.description: PARIS - ​Zinedine Zidane will take charge of France with ‌the weight of history behind him and one of world football’s most gifted squads in front of him, as the 1998 World Cup hero returns to the national team tasked with turning recent near-misses into trophies.

data.title: Hudson confident as Thais prepare for Malaysia test
data.description: Thailand head coach Anthony Hudson has expressed confidence that his side can build on their emphatic opening victory in the Asean Hyundai Cup, as preparations intensify ahead of their second fixture against Malaysia.

data.title: Infantino slams World Cup critics for 'spreading hate'
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - FIFA president Gianni Infantino has hit back at World Cup critics, claiming they were "spreading hate and false rumours" and arguing the tournament delivered "only joy and happiness".

data.title: ONE Championship: Ryujin Nasukawa enters Di Bella’s orbit with statement debut TKO
data.description: Ryujin Nasukawa’s statement debut TKO has added a compelling new name to ONE Championship’s strawweight kickboxing title picture – and a future clash with Jonathan Di Bella already appears inevitable if the Japanese prospect continues his rapid rise.

data.title: Yamaguchi dominates Chen, breaks Chinese hearts
data.description: Japanese badminton star Akane Yamaguchi denied home hope Chen Yufei in the women's singles final of the US$2 million BWF China Open yesterday.

data.title: Aussie great McEvoy masters Commonwealth gold, Ramsay-Peaty hatches battle plan to bounce back
data.description: GLASGOW - Australian swimming great Cameron McEvoy blew away the field to win his first individual Commonwealth Games gold in the 50 metres freestyle as England's Adam Ramsay-Peaty bounced back to reach the final of the 50m breaststroke.

data.title: Convincing start for Thailand
data.description: Thailand boss Anthony Hudson made clear that squad places will be decided purely on merit, after the seven-time regional champions opened their Asean Hyundai Cup 2026 Group B campaign in style with a comprehensive 5-0 victory over Laos in Vientiane on Saturday.

data.title: Port seal deal for striker Jude in final summer signing
data.description: Port have confirmed the arrival of Thai-English forward Jude Soonsup-Bell, closing out their transfer business ahead of a gruelling 2026-27 season that will see the club compete on five fronts.

data.title: Norris grabs first race win of season in Hungary
data.description: BUDAPEST - Lando Norris won the Hungarian Grand Prix on Sunday ahead of Max Verstappen, while championship leader Kimi Antonelli recovered from a pre-race penalty to complete the podium in third.

data.title: Malaysia steps in to host Bahrain F1 GP in October
data.description: BUDAPEST - The Bahrain Grand Prix, which was cancelled in April due to the Middle East war, will be held in Malaysia in early October, Formula One organisers announced on Sunday.

data.title: Fury destroys Wach, puts Pattaya in global spotlight
data.description: PATTAYA: Tyson Fury brought heavyweight boxing to an unlikely stage on Friday night as a packed Max Muay Thai Stadium welcomed one of the sport's biggest names for a rare appearance in Thailand. The former world heavyweight champion delivered a dominant performance, forcing veteran Mariusz Wach's corner to retire the Pole after seven one-sided rounds to claim the WBC Humanitarian Belt.

data.title: Thai doubles duo crash out in semis
data.description: Mixed doubles pair Dechapol Puavaranukroh and Supissara Paewsampran bowed out in the semi-finals of the US$2 million BWF China Open on Saturday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Aliff has Prajanchai ‘in my sights’ as mind games begin after historic Sam-A KO
data.description: Aliff Sor Dechapan has warned Prajanchai PongSuphan PK that he is now firmly “in my sights” after finally forcing their long-simmering ONE Championship rivalry towards a title unification fight.

data.title: Tyson Fury dominant in Pattaya tune-up fight
data.description: PATTAYA - Former ⁠world ⁠heavyweight champion ​Tyson Fury forced Polish ​opponent Mariusz ‌Wach to retire in a tune-up bout on Friday for a hoped-for showdown later this year with ​fellow ⁠Briton Anthony Joshua.

data.title: Thai footballers gunning for strong start
data.description: Thailand coach Anthony Hudson has tipped his squad's younger players to make a telling contribution at the Asean Hyundai Cup 2026, as the War Elephants launch their bid for a record eighth title against Laos in Vientiane on Saturday.

data.title: New academy eyes future champions
data.description: Bangkok's newest sporting venture, North Star Park, formally launched its flagship academy on Thursday, with organisers hoping it will produce future tennis grand slam champions and golf major winners.
